name: sage
description: Sage command threat rules (commands.yaml and mac-commands.yaml), regular expressions with the _macros.yaml macros expanded, applied to the whole command as Sage does. Action from the Sage default 'balanced' thresholds: confidence >= 0.85 deny, >= 0.50 ask. A literal prefilter per rule (a word the pattern needs) skips the regex when the word is absent; it does not change results. Not modelled: trusted-domain suppression for CLT-CMD-001/002, URL and package checks, Windows rules.
reuse: copied (rule ids, titles, patterns), with author, link and licence as DRL-1.1 requires
